page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Left margin: notes beside the first and third lines of the division, and one note beside the Pindar reference. Running head at top right; page number at top left. Below the text: one division heading, a passage in capitals, a Greek quotation with its translation, and a signature "LIPS." at right.

main_text.p: III.Ciuil.Cæsar narrat, receptis omnibus in vna castra legionibus, ille suum cum Scipione honorem partitur, classicumque apud eum cani, & alterum iubet Praetorium tendi. Simile Au-Lib. xxii.[?]gustus in Agrippa. & vt Dio ait, siquando simul ad bellum irent, tabernaculum sui simile dabat, & signum ab vtroque peti iubebat. Diuisa quidem castra etiam lego, sed loco etiam diuisa & abiuncta: idque vel ob numerum militum maiorem, vt apud Cannas maiora & minora fuerunt: vel ob alium vsum, vt Cæsar in Ariouistum. Illud rari exempli, vtrumque Consulem conuenisse, & in castris nil mutasse: sed Hastatos ab Hastatis, Principes a Principibus, & sic ordine; itemque Centurionem a Centurione, Tribunum a Tribuno receptos. Quod Claudius Nero & C.Liuius vsurparunt, contra Asdru-balem: sed dumtaxat in vnam noctem, & ad fallendum hostem. Discas tamen ex eo, satis laxè metari solere, cùm tot millia in iisdem locis possent recipere & inferere: expulsis, nisi fallor, & in vacuum ad valla redactis caloni-bus & iumentis plerisque.
main_text.head: DIALOG. VIII. De ministeriis, quæ Tribunis & Equitibus & alibi præ-stantur, item de Excubiis & Stationibus.
main_text.p: SED de Castris ipsis denique iam peregimus, sermone & re haud illepida, sed longa: & subinde cum Pindaro vereor{*}*ne satie-14 veniēs offendat.[?], μὴ κόρῳ ἐλθὼν κνίσῃ[?]. AUD.[?] Harum qui-dem dapum haud satier, te condiente: & vetus illud ve-rum didici,
Οὐ ὡς γε πάντες ἔσθ᾽ ἀρτύσαι καλῶς:

p.i: Condire scitè non cuilibet datum est.

page.notes: The first and third marginal notes are printed at the left edge, with the first note's Roman numeral "III." and the Lib. note's numeral "xxii." read with doubt. The left-margin note beside Pindaro is cut at its start and reads "*ne satie-" with "14 veniēs offendat."; the "14" and the word after "satie-" are doubtful. The Greek after "vereor" is rendered from a faint scan and the verb "κνίσῃ" is doubtful. The abbreviation after the Greek is read as "AUD." with a question mark. The Greek sentence beneath is doubtful in its second word. Long s is printed as a plain s throughout.
